coverage: 2000-present via current + historical governor archives (Braun, Holcomb 2017-2025); Pence-era (2013-2017) pages not yet independently re-verified; 2000-2004 checked against the Indiana Register's undated list of executive orders; plus 7 declarations added by hand: O'Bannon's July 2003 flood emergency, Kernan's May 2004 storm and December 2004 snow emergencies and Pence's January 2014 winter storm order from dated news, Daniels's Executive Orders 06-15 and 08-16 read from the scanned orders (the archive lists only their year), and Braun's April 11, 2025 declaration from the Governor's release. The Register's list also shows state disaster emergencies for the five federal declarations still unmatched (Executive Orders 01-01 for EM-3162, 02-14 for DR-1418, 02-19 for DR-1433, 03-21 for DR-1487 and 04-19, probably for DR-1542) and Executive Order 04-33 for DR-1573, which matches only by date to the December 23, 2004 snow emergency; the Register's texts from before July 2006, which carry the signing dates, are in print only, so those orders are not listed
